Right-hand side of a marginal Stage-1 GAM, gated on the detected count

Source: R/route-c.R
dot-marginal_gam_rhs.Rd

Uses the first m = min(P, floor(n_det / 3) - 1) PC scores, one smooth each, so the unpenalised part of the model (intercept plus one linear term per smooth) has at most n_det / 3 coefficients. m = 0 (fewer than six detected values) gives the intercept-only model lv ~ 1. Each smooth's basis dimension is k = min(10, floor((n_det - 3) / m) + 1), mgcv's default k = 10 whenever there are enough points. The model then has at most 1 + m * (k - 1) <= n_det - 2 coefficients, so its edf is at most n_det - 2 by construction (REML on a larger basis can still interpolate a thin analyte), and k >= 4 always, since m <= n_det / 3 - 1.

Usage

.marginal_gam_rhs(pc_cols, n_det)

Arguments

pc_cols

Character vector of PC score columns, in order (PC1, ...).

n_det

Number of detected observations the GAM is fitted to.

Value

A single string, e.g. "s(PC1, k = 10) + s(PC2, k = 10)" or "1".
